structuredClone preserves Dates, Maps, Sets, typed arrays, undefined and circular references, and throws on functions. JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(x)) stringifies Dates, turns Maps and Sets into empty objects, drops undefined and functions, and throws on cycles. Prefer structuredClone unless the PR deliberately wants a JSON-safe copy. Action: I can look at the flagged line in the PR to say which behaviour applies.

`using x = getResource()` declares a block-scoped binding whose `[Symbol.dispose]()` method is called automatically when the scope exits, including on throw or return, in reverse order of declaration; `await using` does the same with `Symbol.asyncDispose`. An object participates by implementing that method. It needs the esnext.disposable lib, and Symbol.dispose may need a polyfill depending on the Node version. Action: none needed; I can check our tsconfig and Node version if you want to use it.
